description: "Puts a new unit of Pick, Pack, or SLAM work into the pending pool. Puts a new unit of Pick, Pack, or SLAM work into the pending pool. The task is not assigned to any station at creation time — PULL dispatch (`POST /stations/{stationId}/claim-next`) is the only way a task becomes claimed, consistent with this service's rule that work is never pushed to a named station in advance. `cpt` (Committed Processing Time) drives dispatch priority: `claimNext` always selects the earliest-CPT pending task a station is equipped for. This is not idempotent — each call creates a new task with a fresh, server-generated id, even with an identical body.
